system.description:
You and the other casters perform a series of well-orchestrated strikes in sequence with one another back and forth with you performing the final strike.

Each caster makes 2 melee taijutsu attacks against the target creature, dealing their [Unarmed Damage] + 1d12 on a hit. If each caster hits the target with 2 or more melee taijutsu attacks, then each caster can make one more melee taijutsu attack. If the final attacks are successful, the target takes each casters [Unarmed Damage] + 2d12 and are pushed 20 away, landing Prone.

Combination: When this jutsu is cast, increase the number of attacks each caster makes by +1, for every caster beyond the second.
